body_markdown:
NEW YORK, Sept. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Lexeo Therapeutics, Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=3VjtDeVZ_ULI7LenNS0oku9Ycy8LIShmFD20-rVaadka8PcgVNTrmULZH8g5TY4_bx6huEUhOXG14Jbf1i4NeFEKIKtwj_fVCW28NOwfYHA=) (Nasdaq: LXEO) a clinical stage company focused on reshaping the path of genetic diseases with high unmet need, today announced that the Company will participate in a fireside chat at the Stifel 2026 Virtual Cardiometabolic Forum on September 30, 2026 at 9:00am ET.


The event will be webcast live under the[Events & Presentations](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=gJxQPTPjhOd2kRZdbq0GiL6SMs7oYx0kwi_4x3hsPoZCFwKzm9tWedbIhKLrYRvljxicBSOz_0emIcGw997HAber83hHlWf3KRJMzCR2_hh6ZM-DnECMF_Q91Hbgsv8LyMvFeisA4QfyzlmavlYuBw==) tab in the Investors section of the Company’s website. A replay of the webcast will be available on the Lexeo website following the presentation.


**About Lexeo Therapeutics**
Lexeo Therapeutics is a New York City-based, clinical stage company dedicated to reshaping the path of genetic disease. By advancing pioneering science, Lexeo seeks to set a new standard in the treatment of cardiovascular and neurological genetic diseases, charting the path to patient outcomes once thought out of reach. The Company is advancing a portfolio of therapeutic candidates designed to address the underlying genetic causes of disease, including LX2006 for Friedreich ataxia (FA), LX2020 for plakophilin-2 (PKP2) arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy, and others in devastating diseases with high unmet need.
